title: Build: define and assign in the frame model

checklist.step: define changes only the current frame
assign changes the nearest binding, or raises NameError
Every frame assign visits is drawn, in order, and no others

hints: Definition and assignment differ in which frame they are allowed to change.
For assign, compare the frame you are standing in with the frames lookup would pass on its way to the same name.

define writes into one table and is done. assign repeats the lesson's walk: test the current table for the name, write and stop on a hit, otherwise move to that frame's parent; falling off the end is the error case.
